h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kolkata

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kolkata

items.pText: In Kolkata, a neighbourhood park is often used for much more than play. The same ground may host football in the evening, a puja pandal in autumn and a winter fair. FunPlay Systems plans outdoor playground equipment with that kind of shared use in mind. We supply parks, schools and housing complexes across the city from our factory in Vasai, about 1,640 km away.

We have designed and manufactured play equipment since 2002, with in-house roto-moulding and fabrication. For Kolkata, the equipment travels by road and our installation team or a dealer in east India sets it up. Before anything is made, you receive a layout drawing that shows each piece and the safe play area around it.

richText.heading: Placing equipment in a busy para park

c: If your park is used for festivals, keep the play equipment along one edge rather than in the middle. That leaves the open ground free for a pandal or a game and keeps children's equipment away from crowds and temporary wiring. Grouted posts stay firm even when the park is very busy.
Club committees and resident associations often start with swings, a see-saw and a slide, then add a climber later. Our
individual equipment
range lets you build up a park in stages without redoing the layout.

Kolkata is humid for most of the year, and the monsoon from June to September brings frequent waterlogging. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit these conditions, as plastic does not rust and the zinc layer protects the steel. Raise the play area slightly and give it a drainage slope.
Rubber flooring under the equipment dries faster than grass or mud and cushions falls. We supply it along with the play equipment.

richText.heading: Who we supply in and around Kolkata

c: Builders in New Town, Rajarhat and along the EM Bypass need play areas for large housing complexes. Schools want equipment that can take heavy daily use by many children. Parks run by the Kolkata Municipal Corporation and neighbouring municipalities need equipment for crowds.
We also serve

and

outdoor gym equipment in Kolkata
If your society or club has a small budget, start with two or three pieces and plan space for more on the same drawing.
For housing complexes, a themed play station from our
Forestia
jungle range gives a garden a clear centre. Schools tend to ask for swings, see-saws and spring riders that many children can use at once during a break.

Older parks with mature trees often have patchy light and roots near the surface. We place equipment clear of large roots and low branches, and mark the safe area on the drawing so it stays free of benches and lamp posts.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Kolkata?
items.a: Yes. Everything is manufactured at our Vasai factory and sent to Kolkata by road. Our installation team or a dealer in east India installs it at your site. Send us the address and photos of the ground, and we will plan the layout before dispatch.

items.q: Can play equipment stay in a park that is used for pujas?
items.a: Yes, if you plan for it. Keep the equipment on one side of the ground, grouted firmly, so the open area stays free for events. We can mark this on the layout drawing.

items.q: How do we handle waterlogging in the monsoon?
items.a: Build the play area on a slightly raised base with a slope towards a drain, and use rubber flooring under the equipment. Galvanised and roto-moulded parts cope well with wet months.

Our structural parts, meaning galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, carry three years. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry one year. Both cover manufacturing defects when our installation and maintenance instructions are followed.
